title: Partition-Aware Scheduling for Mobile Heterogeneous Inference Co-Execution
abstract: arXiv:2609.14213v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern mobile inference runs on heterogeneous platforms combining mobile GPUs with multiple CPU core clusters. Existing optimizations typically exploit either inter-operator parallelism, by assigning entire operators to CPU cores or to the GPU, or intra-operator parallelism, by partitioning each operator for CPU-GPU co-execution. We consider these two forms of parallelism together, to improve inference latency of tasks that can be represented by a static DAG of operators with predefined input/output tensor shapes (e.g., CNNs or vision transformers). We define the problem of partition-aware DAG scheduling for mobile heterogeneous inference, illustrating that the best strategy depends on the structure of the inference DAG, thus motivating a joint formulation capturing operator partition choices, device assignment, and execution order. We propose an online iterative search framework, which decomposes large DAGs into stages, focuses search

translated_title: 面向移动异构推理协同执行的分区感知调度
translated_abstract: 现代移动推理运行在由移动GPU与多个CPU核心集群组成的异构平台上。现有的优化方法通常只利用其中一种并行方式：要么是算子间并行，即将完整的算子分配给CPU核心或GPU；要么是算子内并行，即将每个算子进行划分以实现CPU-GPU协同执行。我们同时考虑这两种并行形式，以降低可由具有预定义输入/输出张量形状的静态DAG所表示的任务（如CNN或视觉Transformer）的推理延迟。我们定义了面向移动异构推理的分区感知DAG调度问题，并阐明最优策略取决于推理DAG的结构，因此需要一个涵盖算子划分选择、设备分配和执行顺序的联合建模。我们提出了一个在线迭代搜索框架，该框架将大型DAG分解为多个阶段，聚焦搜索
tldr: 提出分区感知的DAG调度方法，联合优化算子划分、设备分配与执行顺序，并给出在线迭代搜索框架，以降低移动异构平台上的推理延迟。
en_tdlr: Proposes partition-aware DAG scheduling that jointly optimizes operator partitioning, device assignment, and execution order, with an online iterative search framework, to reduce inference latency on mobile heterogeneous platforms.
